cohort: 9,645,646 women who gave birth to at least one live baby in China between 2012 and 2018
finding: The rate of preterm birth, particularly late preterm and very preterm births, increased significantly in China between 2012 and 2018 for both singleton and multiple pregnancies.
mod_finding: Women who gave birth in 2018 were less likely to deliver via cesarean section compared to those who gave birth in 2012.
